text_to_speech: I am Anil Sam, Senior Supervisor Lighting and Compositing! I've been in this industry for the past 17 years  and I've been working for Mikros Animation for 14 years.  My role for this show is to assemble all these lighting effects, bring everything together and get back to Nickelodeon for what they're looking for. So we have actually roughly around five teams, and five leads who are handling the show and  under them there are a lot of "prodigies", who work on this brilliant show, and roughly around 50 to 60 people are working with us, with the five leads. So I am taking care of all this, and my role is to enhance the show and to bring what the director is looking for! I do have a passion for watching movie and  the behind-the-scene : how it is made, so I was so curious! So just roam around and identify  the right people who guide me to this industry, then i come to know about Mikros Animation so I just applied and I'm in! I have had a lot of assignments for international movies, international series, advertisements... I've been doing this for these  past 14 years with Mikros Animation... it's great!   The first time I saw the images of the  trailer of the show, I was just surprised! You know it's almost like in a clock: seconds are running and suddenly the hour needle is running. And we never noticed that ! The same thing happened   to the team. We kept on working and then we saw the show with the audio and visual effects, which is all added on top. And then the color corrections once everything else was done.   And at the end, it's looking beautiful, it's  almost near to a feature film.
